tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Sends an email with the given subject and body to the given recipient address.

tools.name: format_email_body
tools.description: Formats the email body used by send_email, applying the standard signature and footer.

tools.name: update_form
tools.description: Updates an existing form. Call get_form first to read the current questions. Do not use create_form for a form that already exists.

tools.name: get_form
tools.description: Reads a form definition. Use update_form instead when you need to change it.
